title: A bassline
goal: Write a short sawtooth bassline in C minor that sits between the kicks.
explain: note(...) plays pitches by name: c2 is the C two octaves below middle C. Angle brackets <a b> pick one item per cycle, so the bass alternates between two 1-bar phrases. Rests on the beat leave room for the kick, which is why techno basslines usually play on the offbeats. decay(0.15).sustain(0) makes each note a short pluck and lpf(700) takes the fizz off the sawtooth.
try_prompt: Write an offbeat sawtooth bassline in C minor in bass.js that leaves space for the kick, alternating two 1-bar phrases.
